cohort: 3,085 antenatal women at gestation >= 28 weeks, including 1,309 high-risk cases and 1,776 normal pregnancy cases, from a rural tertiary center in Northern India.
finding: High-risk pregnancy was associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including increased risk of perinatal morbidities and mortalities such as preterm births, low birth weight, NICU admission, intubation, complications, neonatal deaths, and stillbirths.
